# What's the overtime pay — and what if there were two rates?

> Free overtime pay calculator: standard time-and-a-half for one hourly rate, plus the FLSA weighted-average (blended rate) calculator for a week worked at two or more different pay rates. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
